name: deepread-monorepo
description: DeepRead — AI-Powered Academic Document Assistant with Grounded Citations

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,AI,CLIENT" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run start:server" "npm run start:ai" "npm run start:client"
scripts.seed: npm --prefix server run seed && node scripts/seed_documents.js
scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:ai
